description: Docker is a set of platform as a service products that use OS-level virtualization to deliver software in packages called containers.

audience_guidance.student: Docker runs apps in isolated boxes. If the Docker API is exposed, attackers can create their own boxes to take over the host.
audience_guidance.developer: Use USER instructions in Dockerfile to avoid running as root. Never mount /var/run/docker.sock into a container if avoidable.
audience_guidance.bug_bounty_hunter: Scan for port 2375 or 2376. An exposed unauthenticated Docker API means instant root on the host.
audience_guidance.pentester: Exploit exposed Docker APIs to deploy a privileged container and mount the host filesystem for RCE.
audience_guidance.security_team: Ensure Docker APIs are never exposed over TCP without mTLS. Audit images for vulnerabilities.
